description: Router V3 full-pool activation: live provider verification microtasks (2026-09-18). One tiny PUBLIC completion per provider/model, run from the task worktree. No secrets recorded; every credential redacted.
method: curl POST to each provider's chat endpoint (or `opencode run` for OpenCode-gated free-tier models) with <=120 output tokens; HTTP status, requested model, actual model (from response), latency, and token usage recorded. Rate-limit headers captured where emitted.

probes.actual_model: (account-scoped run, no model id in response)

probes.note: confirms firstmate's earlier per-model split: codestral-2508 usable; small/medium 429 limit-0; large/glm 403 tier_not_allowed (not re-burned here)

probes.error: no longer available to new users; use gemini-3.6-flash

probes.note: one later retry timed out at 30s; treat as transient overload, retest

probes.error: same upstream free-pool 429 as OpenRouter for this model id

probes.note: auto route: Kilo picked the underlying model itself, confirming auto/fallback attribution must come from the response
catalog lists 82 models (HTTP 200); completions unresponsive on tested id

probes.error: FreeTierError: free tier can only be used from within OpenCode (direct API)

probes.note: direct Go API requires x-opencode-session header

opencode_go_usage_semantics.docs_statement: Each model has the following usage limits: 5-hour - 20% of the monthly limit; weekly - 50%; and monthly - 100% (per-model monthly $ limits published per model; source https://opencode.ai/docs/go/ retrieved 2026-09-18)
opencode_go_usage_semantics.live_check: usage before/after one 262-token MiMo V2.5 completion: rolling 3->3, weekly 48->48, monthly 40->40 (integer resolution; the request is far below 1% of any window)
opencode_go_usage_semantics.conclusion: Usage endpoint is aggregate-only and consistent with the documented per-model enforcement being summarized; per-model enforcement itself was NOT verified by a depletion experiment (weekly already at 48% used; exhausting a model risks disrupting real usage). Router models per-route allowance windows as primary with the aggregate pool as conservative fallback; residual uncertainty recorded.
